 Print Picture Credit: X Actor Prabhas shared his best wishes to the team of ‘Aakasamlo Oka Tara’ ahead of its theatrical release on November 20. The ‘Baahubali’ actor posted the film's poster on his Instagram story and praised the dedication of the cast and crew. Dulquer Salmaan , who plays a key role in the film, reshared Prabhas' message and thanked him for his support. Prabhas calls ‘Aakasamlo Oka Tara’ a special film
 Prabhas described ‘Aakasamlo Oka Tara’ as a special film and acknowledged the efforts of the team behind the project. He wrote, “A special film coming from a team whose dedication and commitment speak for themselves. My best wishes to Allu Aravind Garu, Dulquer, Shruti Haasan , Swapna Cinema and the entire team. Wishing you all a grand success! #AakasamLo Oka Tara.” Dulquer Salmaan re-shared Prabhas' Instagram story and expressed his gratitude for the actor's encouragement. Referring to him as “Darling Prabhas Garu”, Dulquer wrote, “Many thanks to everyone's ‘Darling’ Prabhas Garu! For this support.” About ‘Aakasamlo Oka Tara’
 Written and directed by Pavan Sadineni , ‘Aakasamlo Oka Tara’ stars Dulquer Salmaan, debutant Satvika Veeravalli and Shruti Haasan in lead roles. It includes Satvika Veeravalli as Kalpana and Dulquer portraying Krishna. Kalpana is seen as a brilliant student who secures the district's first rank. However, despite her academic achievements, she faces discouragement from those around her, including her parents, who eventually get her married. Krishna becomes her biggest source of support and encourages her to pursue her dreams of becoming an astronaut. Join conversation

 Meanwhile, Shruti Haasan’s character Rohini is seen as an aerospace engineer. Cast of ‘Aakasamlo Oka Tara’
 The film also features Ruhani Sharma, Swasika, Murali Sharma, Gautham Vasudev Menon, Getup Srinu and Praveen in supporting roles. GV Prakash Kumar has composed the music. ‘Aakasamlo Oka Tara’ is scheduled to release in theatres worldwide on November 20, 2026, in multiple languages. Poll Vote & Share your view
